===== ./app/src/main/java/com/example/webedge/GlassSystem.kt =====

package com.example.webedge

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.ViewOutlineProvider
import eightbitlab.com.blurview.BlurTarget
import eightbitlab.com.blurview.BlurView

/**
 * Summit's real-glass renderer.
 *
 * BlurView needs a View and a BlurTarget, unlike the old Drawable-only helper.
 * Keep creation/configuration here so UI code does not need to know BlurView's API.
 * During migration, surfaces not yet converted to real blur use the Drawable fallback
 * methods below, so their existing colors and opacity remain unchanged.
 */
object GlassSystem {
    // Centralized glass tuning. Lower alpha lets more of the page colors pass through.
    // Keep blur radius unchanged so the result remains frosted rather than clear acrylic.
    private const val BLURRED_OVERLAY_ALPHA_LIGHT = 38
    private const val BLURRED_OVERLAY_ALPHA_DARK = 34
    private const val FALLBACK_FILL_ALPHA_LIGHT = 152
    private const val FALLBACK_FILL_ALPHA_DARK = 142

    enum class Preset(val radiusDp: Int, val blurRadiusDp: Float) {
        ADDRESS_BAR(28, 18f),
        TOOLBAR_BUTTON(20, 16f),
        TOAST(22, 18f),
        SUGGESTIONS(22, 18f),
        FIND_BAR(28, 18f),
        MENU_CARD(26, 20f),
        ORB_BUTTON(20, 16f),
        ORB_SUB_BUTTON(16, 14f),
        TABS_DIALOG(0, 24f),
        TABS_BUTTON(24, 14f)
    }

    /**
     * Drawable fallback for surfaces that have not been converted to real blur yet.
     * Keep the previous Summit colors/opacity unchanged during the staged migration.
     */
    fun create(preset: Preset, density: Float, isNight: Boolean): GradientDrawable =
        create(preset.radiusDp, density, isNight)

    fun create(radiusDp: Int, density: Float, isNight: Boolean): GradientDrawable =
        GradientDrawable().apply {
            cornerRadius = radiusDp.coerceAtLeast(0) * density
            setColor(
                if (isNight) Color.argb(FALLBACK_FILL_ALPHA_DARK, 28, 28, 32)
                else Color.argb(FALLBACK_FILL_ALPHA_LIGHT, 255, 255, 255)
            )
            val strokeColor = if (isNight) Color.argb(60, 255, 255, 255)
                else Color.argb(40, 255, 255, 255)
            setStroke((density + 0.5f).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1), strokeColor)
        }

    fun createInputField(radiusDp: Int, density: Float, isNight: Boolean): GradientDrawable =
        GradientDrawable().apply {
            cornerRadius = radiusDp.coerceAtLeast(0) * density
            setColor(
                if (isNight) Color.argb(40, 255, 255, 255)
                else Color.argb(18, 0, 0, 0)
            )
        }

    /** Viá»n kÃ­nh máº£nh váº½ Ä‘Ã¨ lÃªn ná»™i dung (dÃ¹ng khi lá»›p kÃ­nh lá»›n hÆ¡n khung vÃ  bá»‹ cáº¯t). */
    fun createBorder(radiusDp: Int, density: Float, isNight: Boolean): GradientDrawable =
        GradientDrawable().apply {
            cornerRadius = radiusDp * density
            setColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
            setStroke(
                (density + 0.5f).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1),
                if (isNight) Color.argb(68, 255, 255, 255) else Color.argb(46, 255, 255, 255)
            )
        }

    /** Create a BlurView configured for a named glass surface. */
    fun createBlurView(
        context: Context,
        target: BlurTarget,
        preset: Preset,
        density: Float,
        isNight: Boolean,
        overlayColorOverride: Int? = null
    ): BlurView {
        val shape = GradientDrawable().apply {
            cornerRadius = preset.radiusDp * density
            setColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
            val strokeColor = if (isNight) {
                Color.argb(68, 255, 255, 255)
            } else {
                Color.argb(46, 255, 255, 255)
            }
            setStroke((density + 0.5f).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1), strokeColor)
        }

        val overlayColor = overlayColorOverride ?: if (isNight) {
            Color.argb(BLURRED_OVERLAY_ALPHA_DARK, 28, 28, 32)
        } else {
            Color.argb(BLURRED_OVERLAY_ALPHA_LIGHT, 255, 255, 255)
        }

        return BlurView(context).apply {
            background = shape
            outlineProvider = ViewOutlineProvider.BACKGROUND
            clipToOutline = true
            setupWith(target)
                .setBlurRadius(preset.blurRadiusDp * density)
                .setOverlayColor(overlayColor)
        }
    }
}

        private fun requestWebPermissions(request: PermissionRequest) {

        request.deny()
        return
        }
        val supported = request.resources.filter {
        it == PermissionRequest.RESOURCE_VIDEO_CAPTURE ||
        it == PermissionRequest.RESOURCE_AUDIO_CAPTURE
        }.toTypedArray()
        if (supported.isEmpty()) {
        request.deny()
        return
        }
        pendingWebPermissionRequest?.let { previous ->
        if (previous !== request) previous.deny()
        }
        pendingWebPermissionRequest = request
        pendingWebPermissionResources = supported
        val requestedLabels = buildList {
        if (PermissionRequest.RESOURCE_VIDEO_CAPTURE in supported) add("camera")
        if (PermissionRequest.RESOURCE_AUDIO_CAPTURE in supported) add("micro")
        }.joinToString(" vÃ  ")
        val origin = request.origin.host ?: request.origin.toString()
        AlertDialog.Builder(this)

        val missing = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (PermissionRequest.RESOURCE_VIDEO_CAPTURE in supported &&
        !hasRuntimePermission(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)) {
        missing.add(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
        }
        if (PermissionRequest.RESOURCE_AUDIO_CAPTURE in supported &&
        !hasRuntimePermission(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)) {
        missing.add(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }
        if (missing.isEmpty()) finishWebPermissionRequest()
        else webPermissionLauncher.launch(missing.toTypedArray())
        }
        .setOnCancelListener { denyPendingWebPermission() }
        .show()
        }
        private fun finishWebPermissionRequest() {
        val request = pendingWebPermissionRequest ?: return
        val resources = pendingWebPermissionResources
        pendingWebPermissionRequest = null
        pendingWebPermissionResources = emptyArray()
        val allowed = resources.filter {
        when (it) {
        PermissionRequest.RESOURCE_VIDEO_CAPTURE -> hasRuntimePermission(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
        PermissionRequest.RESOURCE_AUDIO_CAPTURE -> hasRuntimePermission(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        else -> false
        }
        }.toTypedArray()
        runCatching {
        if (allowed.isEmpty()) request.deny() else request.grant(allowed)
        }
        }
        private fun denyPendingWebPermission() {
        val request = pendingWebPermissionRequest ?: return
        pendingWebPermissionRequest = null
        pendingWebPermissionResources = emptyArray()
        runCatching { request.deny() }
        }

private fun handleSpecialUrl(url: String, fallbackView: WebView = web): Boolean {
    val uri = try { Uri.parse(url) } catch (_: Exception) { return false }
    val scheme = uri.scheme?.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) ?: return false
    if (scheme in setOf("http", "https", "about", "javascript", "data", "blob", "file")) {
    return false
    }
    return try {
    val intent = if (scheme == "intent") {
    Intent.parseUri(url, Intent.URI_INTENT_SCHEME)
    } else {
    Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri)
    }
    intent.component = null
    intent.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_BROWSABLE)
    val fallback = intent.getStringExtra("browser_fallback_url")?.let {
    val fallbackUri = runCatching { Uri.parse(it) }.getOrNull()
    if (fallbackUri?.scheme.equals("https", ignoreCase = true) ||
    fallbackUri?.scheme.equals("http", ignoreCase = true)) it else null
    }
    when {
    intent.resolveActivity(packageManager) != null -> {
    startActivity(intent)
    true
    }
    !fallback.isNullOrBlank() -> {
    fallbackView.loadUrl(fallback)
    true
    }
    else -> {
    toast("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y á»©ng dá»¥ng Ä‘á»ƒ má»Ÿ liÃªn káº¿t nÃ y")
    true
    }
    }
    } catch (_: Exception) {
    toast("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ má»Ÿ liÃªn káº¿t bÃªn ngoÃ i")
    true
    }
    }
private fun showFullscreenView(
view: View,
callback: WebChromeClient.CustomViewCallback,
requestedOrientationValue: Int? = null
) {
if (!::fullscreenContainer.isInitialized || customVideoView != null) {
callback.onCustomViewHidden()
return
}
customVideoView = view
customVideoCallback = callback
previousRequestedOrientation = requestedOrientation
requestedOrientationValue?.let {
if (it != ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_UNSPECIFIED) requestedOrientation = it
}
(view.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(view)
fullscreenContainer.removeAllViews()
fullscreenContainer.addView(view, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
fullscreenContainer.visibility = View.VISIBLE
fullscreenContainer.bringToFront()
orbController?.setTemporarilyHidden(true)
WindowInsetsControllerCompat(window, root).hide(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
}

private fun exitFullscreenView() {
val view = customVideoView ?: return
if (::fullscreenContainer.isInitialized) {
fullscreenContainer.removeView(view)
fullscreenContainer.visibility = View.GONE
}
customVideoView = null
val callback = customVideoCallback
customVideoCallback = null
previousRequestedOrientation?.let { requestedOrientation = it }
previousRequestedOrientation = null
if (!isActivityDestroyed && !isFinishing && !isDestroyed && ::root.isInitialized) {
WindowInsetsControllerCompat(window, root).show(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
}
syncOrbMenuVisibility()
callback?.onCustomViewHidden()
}

        override fun onPageStarted(view: WebView, url: String, favicon: Bitmap?) {
            tabManager.updateForWebView(view, url, view.title ?: url)
            if (view !== web) return
            currentUrl = url
            view.alpha = 0.6f
            if (!urlBar.hasFocus()) showDomain()
            setBarHidden(false)
            updateNav()
        }

        override fun doUpdateVisitedHistory(view: WebView, url: String, isReload: Boolean) {
            tabManager.updateForWebView(view, url, view.title ?: url)
            if (view !== web) return
            currentUrl = url
            if (!urlBar.hasFocus()) showDomain()
            updateNav()
        }

        override fun onPageCommitVisible(view: WebView, url: String) {
            if (view !== web) return
            injectInsets()
            AnimationSystem.fade(view, 1f, AnimationSystem.SMOOTH)
        }

        override fun onPageFinished(view: WebView, url: String) {
            tabManager.updateForWebView(view, url, view.title ?: url)
            store.addHistory(view.title ?: "", url)
            if (view !== web) return
            injectInsets()
            AnimationSystem.fade(view, 1f)
            currentUrl = url
            updateTabBadge()
        }

        override fun onRenderProcessGone(view: WebView, detail: RenderProcessGoneDetail): Boolean {
            val tab = tabManager.getForWebView(view)
            val lastUrl = view.url
            if (tab != null) {
                if (!lastUrl.isNullOrBlank()) tab.url = lastUrl
                if (tab.webView === view) tab.webView = null
            }
            (view.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(view)
            runCatching { view.destroy() }
            // Android cÃ³ thá»ƒ thu há»“i renderer cá»§a tab ná»n; táº¡o láº¡i tab Ä‘Ã³ khi ngÆ°á»i dÃ¹ng quay vá».
            if (!isActivityDestroyed && tab?.isActive == true) activateTab(tab)
            return true
        }
    }

    private val chromeClient = object : WebChromeClient() {
    override fun onShowCustomView(view: View, callback: CustomViewCallback) {
    showFullscreenView(view, callback)
    }
    override fun onShowCustomView(view: View, requestedOrientation: Int, callback: CustomViewCallback) {
    showFullscreenView(view, callback, requestedOrientation)
    }
    override fun onHideCustomView() {
    exitFullscreenView()
    }
                override fun onCreateWindow(view: WebView, isDialog: Boolean, isUserGesture: Boolean, resultMsg: Message?): Boolean {
        return createPopupWindow(resultMsg)
        }
        override fun onCloseWindow(window: WebView) {
        if (window === popupWebView) closePopupWindow()
        else super.onCloseWindow(window)
        }
        override fun onPermissionRequest(request: PermissionRequest) {
        runOnUiThread { requestWebPermissions(request) }
        }
        override fun onGeolocationPermissionsShowPrompt(origin: String, callback: GeolocationPermissions.Callback) {
        runOnUiThread { requestWebGeolocation(origin, callback) }
        }

override fun onProgressChanged(view: WebView, newProgress: Int) {
            if (view === web) pillProgress.progress = if (newProgress in 1..99) newProgress / 100f else 0f
        }

        override fun onShowFileChooser(
            webView: WebView,
            callback: ValueCallback<Array<Uri>>,
            params: FileChooserParams
        ): Boolean {
            pendingFileCallback?.onReceiveValue(null)
            pendingFileCallback = callback
            return try {
                fileLauncher.launch(params.createIntent())
                true
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                pendingFileCallback = null
                false
            }
        }
    }

    // ---------------- Tiá»‡n Ã­ch giao diá»‡n ----------------

    private fun dp(v: Int): Int = (v * d).toInt()

    private fun ripple(): Int {
        val tv = TypedValue()
        theme.resolveAttribute(android.R.attr.selectableItemBackground, tv, true)
        return tv.resourceId
    }

    private fun onOff(b: Boolean): String = if (b) "Báº­t" else "Táº¯t"

    // ---------------- Hiá»‡u á»©ng ----------------

    // NÃºt kÃ­nh (scale <= 0.9) phá»“ng lÃªn khi nháº¥n, hÃ ng danh sÃ¡ch/tháº» co láº¡i; cáº£ hai nháº£ ra náº£y.
    private fun press(v: View, scale: Float) {
        if (scale <= 0.9f) AnimationSystem.attachGlassPress(v)
        else AnimationSystem.attachPress(v, v, scale)
    }

    private var toastView: TextView? = null

    // ThÃ´ng bÃ¡o nhá» dáº¡ng viÃªn thuá»‘c: trÆ°á»£t lÃªn, tá»± rÃºt láº¡i
    private fun toast(msg: String) {
        toastView?.let { root.removeView(it) }
        val t = TextView(this)
        t.text = msg
        t.textSize = 14f
        t.setTextColor(fg)
        t.background = GlassSystem.create(GlassSystem.Preset.TOAST, d, isNight)
        t.setPadding(dp(18), dp(10), dp(18), dp(10))
        val lp = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            Gravity.BOTTOM or Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
        )
        lp.bottomMargin = maxOf(insetBottom, imeBottom) + dp(10) + dp(BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP) + dp(14)
        root.addView(t, lp)
        toastView = t
        t.alpha = 0f
        t.translationY = dp(24).toFloat()
        AnimationSystem.slideIn(t)
        t.postDelayed({
            AnimationSystem.slideOut(t, dp(16).toFloat()) {
                root.removeView(t)
                if (toastView === t) toastView = null
            }
        }, 1800L)
    }

    // ---------------- Insets / thanh tráº¡ng thÃ¡i ----------------

    private fun applyInsets() {
        val bottom = maxOf(insetBottom, imeBottom) + dp(10)

        val barLp = bar.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams
        barLp.leftMargin = insetLeft + dp(14)
        barLp.rightMargin = insetRight + dp(14)
        barLp.bottomMargin = bottom

        val findLp = findBarContainer.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams
        findLp.leftMargin = insetLeft + dp(16)
        findLp.rightMargin = insetRight + dp(16)
        findLp.bottomMargin = bottom

        val sugLp = suggestBox.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams
        sugLp.leftMargin = insetLeft + dp(16)
        sugLp.rightMargin = insetRight + dp(16)
        sugLp.bottomMargin = bottom + dp(BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP) + dp(8)
        val sugBlurLp = suggestBlurView.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams
        sugBlurLp.leftMargin = sugLp.leftMargin
        sugBlurLp.rightMargin = sugLp.rightMargin
        sugBlurLp.bottomMargin = sugLp.bottomMargin
        suggestBlurView.layoutParams = sugBlurLp

        (bottomFade.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams).height =
            maxOf(insetBottom, imeBottom) + dp(80)

        val webLp = web.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams
        webLp.topMargin = if (store.edgeMode) 0 else insetTop
        webLp.bottomMargin = imeBottom
        web.layoutParams = webLp

        updateTopFade()
        updateBarVisibility()
        layoutMenu()
        root.requestLayout()
        injectInsets()
    }

    // Dáº£i thanh tráº¡ng thÃ¡i: trÃ n viá»n thÃ¬ dÃ¹ng lá»›p má» (hoáº·c mÃ u thanh menu cá»§a trang náº¿u cÃ³),
    // khÃ´ng trÃ n viá»n thÃ¬ luÃ´n lÃ  mÃ u Ä‘áº·c theo mÃ©p trÃªn cá»§a trang
    private fun updateTopFade() {
        val lp = topFade.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams
        val c = solidTop
        val lightBar: Boolean
        if (store.edgeMode && c == null) {
            topFade.background = fadeDrawable
            lp.height = insetTop + dp(16)
            lightBar = !isNight
        } else {
            val col = c ?: pageBg
            topFade.setBackgroundColor(col)
            lp.height = insetTop
            lightBar = ColorUtils.calculateLuminance(col) > 0.5
        }
        topFade.requestLayout()
        WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, root).isAppearanceLightStatusBars = lightBar
    }

    // TÃ´ dáº£i thanh tráº¡ng thÃ¡i theo mÃ u thanh menu cá»§a trang; null = dÃ¹ng lá»›p má» máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh
    private fun applyTopColor(c: Int?) {
        if (c == solidTop) return
        solidTop = c
        updateTopFade()
    }

    // Chá»«a chá»— Ä‘áº§u/cuá»‘i trang cho cÃ¡c thanh vÃ  cháº¡y script xá»­ lÃ½ thanh menu cá»‘ Ä‘á»‹nh
    private fun injectInsets() {
        val edge = store.edgeMode
        val topCss = if (edge) (insetTop / d).toInt() else 0
        val bottomCss = (insetBottom / d).toInt() + 64
        val rule = (if (edge) "padding-top:" + topCss + "px!important;" else "") +
            "padding-bottom:" + bottomCss + "px!important;box-sizing:border-box!important"
        val js = "(function(){var s=document.getElementById('__edge');" +
            "if(!s){s=document.createElement('style');s.id='__edge';" +
            "(document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(s);}" +
            "s.textContent='html{" + rule + "}';})();"
        web.evaluateJavascript(js, null)
        web.evaluateJavascript(
            EDGE_JS.replace("%INSET%", (insetTop / d).toInt().toString())
                .replace("%MODE%", if (edge) "1" else "0"),
            null
        )
    }

    // "áº¨n" nghÄ©a lÃ  thu gá»n: Ã´ Ä‘á»‹a chá»‰ co nhá», hai nÃºt trÃ²n má» Ä‘i; cháº¡m hoáº·c vuá»‘t lÃªn Ä‘á»ƒ má»Ÿ láº¡i
    private fun setBarHidden(hide: Boolean) {
        if (hide && !store.autoHideBar) return
        if (hide == barHidden) return
        barHidden = hide
        AnimationSystem.scaleTo(
            urlPillFrame, if (hide) 0.58f else 1f, if (hide) 0.62f else 1f
        )
        AnimationSystem.scaleTo(urlBar, if (hide) 1.2f else 1f)
        backBtn.isClickable = !hide
        menuBtn.isClickable = !hide
        reloadBtn.isClickable = !hide
        AnimationSystem.fade(backBtn, if (hide) 0f else backAlpha(), AnimationSystem.SMOOTH)
        AnimationSystem.scaleTo(backBtn, if (hide) 0.5f else 1f)
        AnimationSystem.fade(menuBtn, if (hide) 0f else 1f, AnimationSystem.SMOOTH)
        AnimationSystem.scaleTo(menuBtn, if (hide) 0.5f else 1f)
        AnimationSystem.fade(reloadBtn, if (hide) 0f else 1f, AnimationSystem.SMOOTH)
        AnimationSystem.fade(bottomFade, if (hide) 0.35f else 1f, AnimationSystem.SMOOTH)
        syncOrbMenuVisibility()
    }

    // OrbMenu cÃ³ tráº¡ng thÃ¡i riÃªng, khÃ´ng suy diá»…n tá»« alpha cá»§a nÃºt quay láº¡i:
    // nÃºt quay láº¡i cÃ³ thá»ƒ má» vÃ¬ khÃ´ng cÃ²n lá»‹ch sá»­ nhÆ°ng OrbMenu váº«n cáº§n dÃ¹ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c.
    private fun syncOrbMenuVisibility() {
        if (!::findBarContainer.isInitialized || !::bar.isInitialized || !::urlBar.isInitialized) return
        val findOn = findBarContainer.visibility == View.VISIBLE
        val pageTyping = imeBottom > 0 && !urlBar.hasFocus() && !findOn
        val toolbarAvailable = bar.visibility == View.VISIBLE && !barHidden
        val inFullscreen = customVideoView != null
        orbController?.setToolbarAvailable(toolbarAvailable && !inFullscreen)
        orbController?.setTemporarilyHidden(findOn || pageTyping || inFullscreen)
    }

    // áº¨n thanh Ä‘á»‹a chá»‰ khi Ä‘ang gÃµ trong Ã´ nháº­p cá»§a trang (trÃ¡nh che ná»™i dung), hoáº·c khi Ä‘ang tÃ¬m trong trang.
    private fun updateBarVisibility() {
        val findOn = findBarContainer.visibility == View.VISIBLE
        val pageTyping = imeBottom > 0 && !urlBar.hasFocus() && !findOn
        bar.visibility = if (findOn || pageTyping) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
        bottomFade.visibility = if (pageTyping) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
        syncOrbMenuVisibility()
    }

    private fun backAlpha(): Float = if (web.canGoBack()) 1f else 0.3f

    private fun updateNav() {
        backBtn.alpha = if (barHidden) 0f else backAlpha()
    }

    // ---------------- Thanh Ä‘á»‹a chá»‰ ----------------

    private fun setUrlText(text: String) {
        programmatic = true
        urlBar.setText(text)
        programmatic = false
    }

    private fun showDomain() {
        val host = try {
            Uri.parse(currentUrl).host
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
        setUrlText(host?.removePrefix("www.") ?: "")
    }

    private fun leaveEdit() {
        root.requestFocus()
        WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, urlBar).hide(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.ime())
    }

    // ---------------- Gá»£i Ã½ tÃ¬m kiáº¿m ----------------

    private fun scheduleSuggest(q: String) {
        suggestRunnable?.let { handler.removeCallbacks(it) }
        val text = q.trim()
        if (text.isEmpty()) {
            hideSuggestions()
            return
        }
        val r = Runnable { fetchSuggestions(text) }
        suggestRunnable = r
        handler.postDelayed(r, 150)
    }

    private fun fetchSuggestions(q: String) {
        suggestToken++
        val token = suggestToken
        val engine = store.searchEngine
        Thread {
            val result = try {
                requestSuggestions(engine, q)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                emptyList<String>()
            }
            runOnUiThread {
                if (!isActivityDestroyed && token == suggestToken && urlBar.hasFocus()) showSuggestions(result)
            }
        }.start()
    }

    private fun requestSuggestions(engine: Int, q: String): List<String> {
        val enc = URLEncoder.encode(q, "UTF-8")
        val link = when (engine) {
            1 -> "https://api.bing.com/osjson.aspx?query=" + enc
            2 -> "https://duckduckgo.com/ac/?type=list&q=" + enc
            else -> "https://suggestqueries.google.com/complete/search?client=firefox&q=" + enc
        }
        val conn = URL(link).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        conn.connectTimeout = 3000
        conn.readTimeout = 3000
        conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0")
        try {
            val body = conn.inputStream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() }
            val arr = JSONArray(body).getJSONArray(1)
            val out = ArrayList<String>()
            for (i in 0 until minOf(arr.length(), 6)) out.add(arr.getString(i))
            return out
        } finally {
            conn.disconnect()
        }
    }

    private fun showSuggestions(items: List<String>) {
        suggestBox.removeAllViews()
        if (items.isEmpty()) {
            suggestBox.visibility = View.GONE
            suggestBlurView.visibility = View.GONE
            return
        }
        val rp = ripple()
        for (text in items) {
            val row = LinearLayout(this)
            row.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            row.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            row.setPadding(dp(18), 0, dp(18), 0)
            row.setBackgroundResource(rp)
            val ic = ImageView(this)
            ic.setImageDrawable(PathIcon(Icons.SEARCH, sub))
            row.addView(ic, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(18), dp(18)))
            val t = TextView(this)
            t.text = text
            t.textSize = 15f
            t.setTextColor(fg)
            t.setSingleLine()
            t.ellipsize = TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
            t.setPadding(dp(12), 0, 0, 0)
            row.addView(t, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
            row.setOnClickListener {
                load(text)
                leaveEdit()
            }
            press(row, 0.98f)
            suggestBox.addView(row, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(44)))
        }
        suggestBlurView.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        suggestBox.visibility = View.VISIBLE
    }

    private fun hideSuggestions() {
        suggestToken++
        suggestRunnable?.let { handler.removeCallbacks(it) }
        suggestBox.visibility = View.GONE
        suggestBlurView.visibility = View.GONE
        suggestBox.removeAllViews()
    }

    private fun openFind() {
        // Hide OrbMenu before requesting the keyboard so neither its ring nor its sub-buttons
        // can remain visible/touchable over FindBar during the IME animation.

        updateBarVisibility()
        findInput.requestFocus()
        WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, findInput).show(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.ime())
    }

        web.clearMatches()
        findInput.setText("")
        findBarContainer.visibility = View.GONE

    }

    // ---------------- Táº£i trang ----------------

    private fun searchBase(): String = when (store.searchEngine) {
        1 -> "https://www.bing.com/search?q="
        2 -> "https://duckduckgo.com/?q="
        else -> "https://www.google.com/search?q="
    }

    private fun toUrl(input: String): String {
        val t = input.trim()
        return when {
            t.startsWith("http://") || t.startsWith("https://") -> t
            t.contains(".") && !t.contains(" ") -> "https://" + t
            else -> searchBase() + Uri.encode(t)
        }
    }

    private fun load(input: String) {
        if (input.isBlank()) return
        web.loadUrl(toUrl(input))
    }

    private fun applyDesktopMode(target: WebView = web) {
        val settings = target.settings
        if (store.desktopMode) {
            settings.userAgentString = DESKTOP_UA
            settings.useWideViewPort = true
            settings.loadWithOverviewMode = true
        } else {
            settings.userAgentString = mobileUa
            settings.useWideViewPort = false
            settings.loadWithOverviewMode = false
        }
    }

    /** Má»—i tab cÃ³ cáº¥u hÃ¬nh/client riÃªng nhÆ°ng váº«n dÃ¹ng chung cache vÃ  cookie Chromium. */
    @SuppressLint("SetJavaScriptEnabled")
    private fun configureTabWebView(view: WebView) {
        view.setBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE)
        val settings = view.settings
        settings.javaScriptEnabled = true
        settings.domStorageEnabled = true
        settings.databaseEnabled = true
        settings.setSupportMultipleWindows(true)
        settings.javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically = true
        settings.mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture = false
        settings.mixedContentMode = WebSettings.MIXED_CONTENT_COMPATIBILITY_MODE
        if (mobileUa.isBlank()) {
            mobileUa = settings.userAgentString
                .replace(Regex(""";\s*wv""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), "")
                .replace(Regex("""\s*Version/4\.0""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), "")
        }
        applyDesktopMode(view)
        CookieManager.getInstance().apply {
            setAcceptCookie(true)
            setAcceptThirdPartyCookies(view, true)
        }
        view.webViewClient = client
        view.webChromeClient = chromeClient
        view.addJavascriptInterface(Bridge(view), "EdgeBridge")
        view.setFindListener { active, total, _ ->
            if (view === web) findCount.text = if (total == 0) "0" else "${active + 1}/$total"
        }
        view.setDownloadListener { dlUrl, userAgent, contentDisposition, mimetype, _ ->
            try {
                val req = DownloadManager.Request(Uri.parse(dlUrl))
                req.setMimeType(mimetype)
                CookieManager.getInstance().getCookie(dlUrl)?.let { req.addRequestHeader("cookie", it) }
                req.addRequestHeader("User-Agent", userAgent)
                req.setNotificationVisibility(DownloadManager.Request.VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_NOTIFY_COMPLETED)
                req.setDestinationInExternalPublicDir(
                    Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS,
                    URLUtil.guessFileName(dlUrl, contentDisposition, mimetype)
                )
                (getSystemService(DOWNLOAD_SERVICE) as DownloadManager).enqueue(req)
                toast("Äang táº£i xuá»‘ng...")
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                toast("KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c file nÃ y")
            }
        }
        view.setOnScrollChangeListener { _, _, y, _, oldY ->
            if (view !== web || urlBar.hasFocus()) return@setOnScrollChangeListener
            val dy = y - oldY
            if (dy > 12) setBarHidden(true)
            else if (dy < -12 || y < 10) setBarHidden(false)
        }
    }

    private fun captureActiveTab() {
        if (::web.isInitialized) tabManager.saveState(web)
    }

    private fun activateTab(tab: TabManager.Tab) {
        val target = tab.webView ?: WebView(this).also { created ->
            configureTabWebView(created)
            tab.webView = created
        }
        val previous = if (::web.isInitialized) web else null
        if (previous !== target) {
            previous?.let { old ->
                runCatching { old.onPause() }
                (old.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(old)
            }
            (target.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(target)
            web = target
            blurTarget.addView(target, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
            runCatching { target.onResume() }
        }
        tabManager.switchTo(tab.id)
        currentUrl = target.url ?: tab.url
        target.alpha = 1f
        pillProgress.progress = 0f
        applyInsets()
        if (target.url.isNullOrBlank()) {
            load(tab.url.ifBlank { store.homeUrl })
        } else {
            if (target.progress >= 100) target.post { if (web === target) injectInsets() }
            if (!urlBar.hasFocus()) showDomain()
            updateNav()
        }
        updateTabBadge()
    }

    private fun createBrowserTab() {
        val tab = tabManager.addNew(title = "Tab má»›i")
        activateTab(tab)
    }

    private fun closeBrowserTab(tab: TabManager.Tab) {
        val wasActive = tab.isActive
        if (wasActive) captureActiveTab()
        val removed = tabManager.close(tab.id) ?: return
        if (wasActive) tabManager.getActive()?.let(::activateTab)
        removed.webView?.let { view -> if (view !== web) destroyTabWebView(view) }
    }

    private fun destroyTabWebView(view: WebView) {
        runCatching { view.stopLoading() }
        runCatching { view.removeJavascriptInterface("EdgeBridge") }
        runCatching { view.webViewClient = WebViewClient() }
        runCatching { view.webChromeClient = WebChromeClient() }
        runCatching { view.setDownloadListener(null) }
        runCatching { view.setFindListener(null) }
        runCatching { view.setOnScrollChangeListener(null as View.OnScrollChangeListener?) }
        runCatching { view.onPause() }
        (view.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(view)
        runCatching { view.loadUrl("about:blank") }
        runCatching { view.removeAllViews() }
        runCatching { view.destroyDrawingCache() }
        runCatching { view.destroy() }
    }

    // ---------------- Menu ba cháº¥m: má»Ÿ táº¡i chá»—, Ä‘á»•i trang ngay trong khung ----------------

    private fun openMenu() {
        if (menuLayer != null) {
            closeMenu()
            return
        }
        val layer = FrameLayout(this)
        layer.setOnClickListener { closeMenu() }

        val card = MenuCardLayout(this).apply {
            // Ná»n kÃ­nh dá»± phÃ²ng + outline bo gÃ³c Ä‘á»ƒ menu khÃ´ng thÃ nh trong suá»‘t
            // náº¿u BlurView chÆ°a render ká»‹p trong láº§n layout Ä‘áº§u tiÃªn.
            background = GlassSystem.create(GlassSystem.Preset.MENU_CARD, d, isNight)
            clipToOutline = true
            clipChildren = true
            clipToPadding = true
            isClickable = true
            // Lá»›p kÃ­nh lá»›n hÆ¡n khung vÃ  bá»‹ cáº¯t bo gÃ³c, nÃªn viá»n kÃ­nh váº½ Ä‘Ã¨ lÃªn trÃªn.
            foreground = GlassSystem.createBorder(GlassSystem.Preset.MENU_CARD.radiusDp, d, isNight)
        }

        val glass = GlassSystem.createBlurView(
            this,
            blurTarget,
            GlassSystem.Preset.MENU_CARD,
            d,
            isNight
        )
        glass.isClickable = false
        glass.isFocusable = false
        // KÃ­nh cÃ³ kÃ­ch thÆ°á»›c cá»‘ Ä‘á»‹nh, Ä‘á»§ lá»›n cho má»i trang; MenuCardLayout bá» qua nÃ³ khi Ä‘o
        // nÃªn card váº«n Ã´m theo ná»™i dung. KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»•i kÃ­ch thÆ°á»›c => blur cÃ³ ngay, khÃ´ng bá»‹ trong suá»‘t.
        val glassW = minOf(dp(400), resources.displayMetrics.widthPixels - dp(28) - insetLeft - insetRight)
        card.addView(glass, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(glassW, menuMaxHeight()))

        layer.addView(
            card,
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                Gravity.BOTTOM or Gravity.END
            )
        )
        root.addView(layer, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
        menuLayer = layer
        menuCard = card
        layoutMenu()
        showMainPage(false)

        card.alpha = 0f
        card.scaleX = 0.8f
        card.scaleY = 0.8f
        card.post {
            card.pivotX = card.width.toFloat()
            card.pivotY = card.height.toFloat()
            AnimationSystem.popIn(card, 0.6f)
        }
    }

    private fun closeMenu() {
        val layer = menuLayer ?: return
        val card = menuCard
        menuLayer = null
        menuCard = null
        menuBackAction = null
        if (card == null) {
            root.removeView(layer)
            return
        }
        // Thu há»“i: co láº¡i vá» gÃ³c dÆ°á»›i bÃªn pháº£i, phÃ­a nÃºt ba cháº¥m.
        card.pivotX = card.width.toFloat()
        card.pivotY = card.height.toFloat()
        AnimationSystem.popOut(card, 0.3f) { root.removeView(layer) }
    }

    // Äáº·t vá»‹ trÃ­ khung menu ngay phÃ­a trÃªn nÃºt ba cháº¥m
    private fun layoutMenu() {
        val layer = menuLayer ?: return
        val card = menuCard ?: return
        layer.setPadding(0, insetTop + dp(12), 0, 0)
        val lp = card.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams
        lp.rightMargin = insetRight + dp(14)
        lp.bottomMargin = maxOf(insetBottom, imeBottom) + dp(10) + dp(BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP) + dp(8)
        card.layoutParams = lp
    }

    private fun menuMaxHeight(): Int {
        val rootH = if (root.height > 0) root.height else resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels
        val maxH = rootH - insetTop - dp(12) -
            (maxOf(insetBottom, imeBottom) + dp(10) + dp(BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP) + dp(8))
        return maxOf(maxH, dp(120))
    }

    // Thay ná»™i dung khung menu báº±ng má»™t trang khÃ¡c, cÃ³ hiá»‡u á»©ng Ä‘á»•i kÃ­ch thÆ°á»›c
    private fun setMenuPage(page: View, widthDp: Int, animate: Boolean) {
        val layer = menuLayer ?: return
        val card = menuCard ?: return
        val w = minOf(dp(widthDp), resources.displayMetrics.widthPixels - dp(28) - insetLeft - insetRight)
        val glass = card.getChildAt(0)
        if (animate) {
            // Fade vÃ  Ä‘á»•i kÃ­ch thÆ°á»›c cháº¡y Ä‘á»“ng thá»i (AutoTransition cháº¡y láº§n lÆ°á»£t nÃªn ráº¥t cháº­m).
            val tr = TransitionSet()
            tr.ordering = TransitionSet.ORDERING_TOGETHER
            tr.addTransition(Fade(Fade.OUT).setDuration(80))
            tr.addTransition(
                ChangeBounds()
                    .setDuration(AnimationSystem.PAGE_DURATION)
                    .setInterpolator(AnimationSystem.pageInterpolator)
            )
            tr.addTransition(Fade(Fade.IN).setDuration(180).setStartDelay(40))
            // Lá»›p kÃ­nh Ä‘á»•i kÃ­ch thÆ°á»›c ngay, khÃ´ng animate, Ä‘á»ƒ blur khÃ´ng pháº£i dá»±ng láº¡i má»—i khung hÃ¬nh.
            tr.excludeTarget(glass, true)
            TransitionManager.beginDelayedTransition(layer, tr)
        }
        if (card.childCount > 1) {
            card.removeViews(1, card.childCount - 1)
        }
        card.addView(page, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(w, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT))

        WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, layer).hide(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.ime())
    }

    private fun showMainPage(animate: Boolean = true) {
        val gapColor = Theme.gapColor(isNight)
        val rp = ripple()

        val box = LinearLayout(this)
        box.orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
        box.setPadding(0, dp(8), 0, dp(8))

        fun cell(row: LinearLayout, label: String, path: String, action: () -> Unit) {
            val c = LinearLayout(this)
            c.orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            c.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            c.setBackgroundResource(rp)
            val iv = ImageView(this)
            iv.setImageDrawable(PathIcon(path, fg))
            c.addView(iv, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(20), dp(20)))
            val t = TextView(this)
            t.text = label
            t.textSize = 11.5f
            t.setTextColor(fg)
            t.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            t.setPadding(0, dp(5), 0, 0)
            c.addView(t, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT))
            c.setOnClickListener {
                closeMenu()
                action()
            }
            press(c, 0.92f)
            row.addView(c, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f))
        }

        // closes = true: Ä‘Ã³ng menu rá»“i thá»±c hiá»‡n; false: má»Ÿ trang má»›i ngay trong khung menu
        fun item(label: String, path: String?, closes: Boolean, action: () -> Unit) {
            val r = LinearLayout(this)
            r.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            r.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            r.setPadding(dp(22), 0, dp(22), 0)
            r.setBackgroundResource(rp)
            val t = TextView(this)
            t.text = label
            t.textSize = 15f
            t.setTextColor(fg)
            r.addView(t, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
            if (path != null) {
                val iv = ImageView(this)
                iv.setImageDrawable(PathIcon(path, fg))
                r.addView(iv, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(22), dp(22)))
            }
            r.setOnClickListener {
                if (closes) closeMenu()
                action()
            }
            press(r, 0.98f)
            box.addView(r, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(50)))
        }

        fun gap() {
            val g = View(this)
            g.setBackgroundColor(gapColor)
            box.addView(g, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(6)))
        }

        val marked = store.isBookmarked(currentUrl)

        val quick = LinearLayout(this)
        quick.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
        quick.setPadding(dp(8), 0, dp(8), 0)
        cell(quick, "Chia sáº»", Icons.SHARE) { shareUrl() }
        cell(
            quick,
            if (marked) "Bá» lÆ°u" else "LÆ°u trang",
            if (marked) Icons.BOOKMARK else Icons.BOOKMARK_OUTLINE
        ) { toggleBookmark() }
        cell(quick, "Táº£i láº¡i", Icons.REFRESH) { web.reload() }
        box.addView(quick, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(70)))

        gap()
        item("Dáº¥u trang", Icons.BOOKMARK_OUTLINE, false) { showList("Dáº¥u trang", "bookmarks") }
        item("Lá»‹ch sá»­", Icons.HISTORY, false) { showList("Lá»‹ch sá»­", "history") }
        item("Táº£i xuá»‘ng", Icons.DOWNLOAD, true) { openDownloads() }

        gap()
        item("TÃ¬m trong trang", Icons.SEARCH, true) { openFind() }
        item("Trang web mÃ¡y tÃ­nh", if (store.desktopMode) Icons.CHECK else null, true) {
            store.desktopMode = !store.desktopMode
            applyDesktopMode()
            web.reload()
        }

        gap()
        item("CÃ i Ä‘áº·t", Icons.TUNE, false) { showSettings() }

        menuBackAction = null
        setMenuPage(box, 280, animate)
    }

    private fun toggleBookmark() {
        if (currentUrl.isBlank()) return
        val added = store.toggleBookmark(web.title ?: currentUrl, currentUrl)
        toast(if (added) "ÄÃ£ thÃªm dáº¥u trang" else "ÄÃ£ bá» dáº¥u trang")
    }

    private fun shareUrl() {
        if (currentUrl.isBlank()) return
        val i = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND)
        i.type = "text/plain"
        i.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, currentUrl)
        startActivity(Intent.createChooser(i, "Chia sáº»"))
    }

    private fun openDownloads() {
        try {
            startActivity(Intent(DownloadManager.ACTION_VIEW_DOWNLOADS))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            toast("KhÃ´ng má»Ÿ Ä‘Æ°á»£c danh sÃ¡ch táº£i xuá»‘ng")
        }
    }

    // ---------------- CÃ¡c trang trong khung menu ----------------

    private fun makePanel(title: String, hint: String?, widthDp: Int, onBack: (() -> Unit)?): Panel {
        val page = LinearLayout(this)
        page.orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL

        val head = LinearLayout(this)
        head.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
        head.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        head.setPadding(if (onBack != null) dp(6) else dp(22), dp(12), dp(22), dp(2))
        if (onBack != null) {
            val back = ImageView(this)
            back.setImageDrawable(PathIcon(Icons.ARROW_BACK, fg))
            back.setPadding(dp(9), dp(9), dp(9), dp(9))
            back.setOnClickListener { onBack() }
            press(back, 0.85f)
            head.addView(back, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(40), dp(40)))
        }
        val t = TextView(this)
        t.text = title
        t.textSize = 18f
        t.setTextColor(fg)
        t.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
        t.setPadding(if (onBack != null) dp(4) else 0, 0, 0, 0)
        head.addView(t)
        page.addView(head)

        if (hint != null) {
            val h = TextView(this)
            h.text = hint
            h.textSize = 12f
            h.setTextColor(sub)
            h.setPadding(dp(22), 0, dp(22), dp(6))
            page.addView(h)
        }

        val body = LinearLayout(this)
        body.orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
        val scroll = ScrollView(this)
        scroll.addView(body)
        page.addView(scroll, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f))

        val buttons = LinearLayout(this)
        buttons.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
        buttons.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        buttons.setPadding(dp(22), dp(4), dp(22), dp(10))
        page.addView(buttons)

        return Panel(page, body, buttons, widthDp, onBack)
    }

    private fun showPanel(p: Panel) {
        menuBackAction = p.onBack
        setMenuPage(p.page, p.widthDp, true)
    }

    private fun panelButton(text: String, color: Int, onClick: () -> Unit): TextView {
        val b = TextView(this)
        b.text = text
        b.textSize = 15f
        b.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
        b.setTextColor(color)
        b.setPadding(0, dp(6), 0, dp(6))
        b.setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        press(b, 0.9f)
        return b
    }

    private fun addButtons(p: Panel, left: TextView?, right: TextView) {
        if (left != null) p.buttons.addView(left)
        p.buttons.addView(View(this), LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, 1, 1f))
        p.buttons.addView(right)
    }

    // RÃºt gá»n link: chá»‰ hiá»‡n tÃªn miá»n + Ä‘Æ°á»ng dáº«n, bá» pháº§n tham sá»‘ dÃ i
    private fun shortUrl(url: String): String {
        return try {
            val u = Uri.parse(url)
            val host = u.host?.removePrefix("www.") ?: return url
            val path = u.path ?: ""
            if (path.length > 1) host + path else host
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            url
        }
    }

    private fun showList(title: String, key: String) {
        val p = makePanel(title, "Cháº¡m Ä‘á»ƒ má»Ÿ, giá»¯ lÃ¢u Ä‘á»ƒ xÃ³a", 340) { showMainPage() }
        val rp = ripple()

        var fillGen = 0
        fun fill() {
            p.body.removeAllViews()
            val myGen = ++fillGen
            val current = store.list(key).take(100)
            if (current.isEmpty()) {
                val empty = TextView(this)
                empty.text = "ChÆ°a cÃ³ gÃ¬"
                empty.textSize = 15f
                empty.setTextColor(sub)
                empty.setPadding(dp(22), dp(16), dp(22), dp(16))
                p.body.addView(empty)
                return
            }
            // Dá»±ng 10 hÃ ng Ä‘áº§u ngay Ä‘á»ƒ trang hiá»‡n tá»©c thÃ¬, pháº§n cÃ²n láº¡i dá»±ng ngay sau Ä‘Ã³.
            fun build(from: Int, to: Int) { for (entry in current.subList(from, minOf(to, current.size))) {
                val row = LinearLayout(this)
                row.orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
                row.setPadding(dp(22), dp(10), dp(22), dp(10))
                row.setBackgroundResource(rp)

                val t = TextView(this)

                t.textSize = 15f
                t.setTextColor(fg)
                t.setSingleLine()
                t.ellipsize = TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
                row.addView(t)

                val u = TextView(this)
                u.text = shortUrl(entry.url)
                u.textSize = 12f
                u.setTextColor(sub)
                u.setSingleLine()
                u.ellipsize = TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
                row.addView(u)

                row.setOnClickListener {
                    closeMenu()
                    load(entry.url)
                }
                row.setOnLongClickListener {
                    store.remove(key, entry.url)
                    fill()
                    true
                }
                press(row, 0.98f)
                p.body.addView(row, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT))
            } }
            build(0, 10)
            if (current.size > 10) {
                p.body.post { if (myGen == fillGen) build(10, current.size) }
            }
        }
        fill()

        val left: TextView? = if (key == "history") {
            panelButton("XÃ³a táº¥t cáº£", accent) {

                fill()
            }
        } else null
        addButtons(p, left, panelButton("Xong", accent) { closeMenu() })
        showPanel(p)
    }

                    runCatching { tabWeb.clearHistory() }

                }
                CookieManager.getInstance().removeAllCookies(null)

    // Gom nhiá»u thay Ä‘á»•i liÃªn tiáº¿p (url/title Ä‘á»•i liÃªn tá»¥c khi táº£i trang) thÃ nh má»™t láº§n ghi.
    private val saveTabsRunnable = Runnable { store.saveTabs(tabManager.exportTabs()) }

    private fun scheduleSaveTabs() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(saveTabsRunnable)
        handler.postDelayed(saveTabsRunnable, 600)
    }

    override fun onPause() {
        if (::web.isInitialized) {
            tabManager.saveState(web)
            handler.removeCallbacks(saveTabsRunnable)
            store.saveTabs(tabManager.exportTabs())
        }
        super.onPause()
    }

    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        if (::web.isInitialized) {
            tabManager.saveState(web)
            store.saveTabs(tabManager.exportTabs())
            web.saveState(outState)
        }
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
    }

    private fun setupOrbMenu() {
        orbController = OrbMenuController(
            blurTarget = blurTarget,
            rootLayout = root,
            dp = { dp(it) },
            d = d,
            isNight = isNight,
            BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP = BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP,
            onBack = { if (web.canGoBack()) web.goBack() },
            onForward = { if (web.canGoForward()) web.goForward() },
            onHome = { load(store.homeUrl) }
        )
        orbController?.alignWith(backBtn)
        backBtn.visibility = View.INVISIBLE
        backBtn.setOnClickListener(null)
        syncOrbMenuVisibility()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        isActivityDestroyed = true
        denyPendingWebPermission()
        pendingGeoCallback?.invoke(pendingGeoOrigin.orEmpty(), false, false)
        pendingGeoCallback = null
        pendingGeoOrigin = null
        popupDialog?.dismiss()
        if (customVideoView != null) exitFullscreenView()
        suggestToken++
        // === CLEANUP DE TRANH MEMORY LEAK ===
        // 1. Gá»¡ JS interface (trÃ¡nh inner class Bridge giá»¯ reference)
        web.removeJavascriptInterface("EdgeBridge")

        // 2. Gá»¡ listeners khá»i WebView
        web.webViewClient = WebViewClient()
        web.webChromeClient = WebChromeClient()
        web.setDownloadListener(null)
        web.setFindListener(null)
        web.setOnScrollChangeListener(null as View.OnScrollChangeListener?)

        // 3. Há»§y táº¥t cáº£ Runnable Ä‘ang chá» trong Handler
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
        suggestRunnable?.let { handler.removeCallbacks(it) }
        suggestRunnable = null

        // 4. Há»§y callbacks
        pendingFileCallback?.onReceiveValue(null)
        pendingFileCallback = null

        // 5. Cleanup Orb Menu Controller (gá»¡ PreDrawListener)
        orbController?.destroy()
        orbController = null

        // 6. Destroy every tab WebView last, including views detached in the background.
        val tabViews = tabManager.getAll().mapNotNull { it.webView }.distinct()
        tabManager.getAll().forEach {
            it.thumbnail?.recycle()
            it.thumbnail = null
            it.thumbnailUrl = null
            it.webView = null
        }
        // Do not clear persistent WebView cache/history during ordinary Activity teardown.
        tabViews.forEach(::destroyTabWebView)

        super.onDestroy()
    }


    // ==========================================
    // MULTI-TAB: Badge + Tab Switcher
    // ==========================================
    private class BadgeDrawable(
        private val count: Int,
        private val bgColor: Int,
        private val textColor: Int,
        private val d: Float
    ) : android.graphics.drawable.Drawable() {
        private val bgPaint = android.graphics.Paint(android.graphics.Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = bgColor }
        private val textPaint = android.graphics.Paint(android.graphics.Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            color = textColor
            textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER
            textSize = 10 * d
            typeface = android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
        }
        override fun draw(canvas: android.graphics.Canvas) {
            val b = bounds
            if (b.width() <= 0 || b.height() <= 0) return
            val cx = b.exactCenterX()
            val cy = b.exactCenterY()
            val r = minOf(b.width(), b.height()) / 2f
            canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, r, bgPaint)
            val text = if (count > 99) "99+" else count.toString()
            val y = cy - (textPaint.descent() + textPaint.ascent()) / 2f
            canvas.drawText(text, cx, y, textPaint)
        }
        override fun setAlpha(alpha: Int) {}
        override fun setColorFilter(cf: android.graphics.ColorFilter?) {}
        @Suppress("OVERRIDE_DEPRECATION")
        override fun getOpacity(): Int = android.graphics.PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
    }

    private fun updateTabBadge() {
        val count = tabManager.count()
        val base = PathIcon(Icons.TABS, fg)
        if (count <= 1) {
            tabBtn.setImageDrawable(base)
            return
        }
        val badgeColor = if (isNight) Color.rgb(50, 140, 255) else Color.rgb(10, 132, 255)
        val textColor = if (isNight) Color.BLACK else Color.WHITE
        val layer = android.graphics.drawable.LayerDrawable(arrayOf(
            base,
            BadgeDrawable(count, badgeColor, textColor, d)
        ))
        layer.setLayerInset(1, dp(14), 0, 0, dp(14))
        tabBtn.setImageDrawable(layer)
    }


    private lateinit var tabSwitcherController: TabSwitcherController

    private fun openTabSwitcher(animate: Boolean = true) {
        tabSwitcherController.show(animate)
    }
}

class PathIcon(pathData: String, color: Int) : Drawable() {
    private val path: Path? = try {
        PathParser.createPathFromPathData(pathData)
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        null
    }
    private val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        this.color = color
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
    }
    override fun draw(canvas: Canvas) {
        val p = path ?: return
        val b = bounds
        if (b.width() <= 0 || b.height() <= 0) return
        val sc = b.width() / 24f
        canvas.save()
        canvas.translate(b.left.toFloat(), b.top.toFloat())
        canvas.scale(sc, sc)
        canvas.drawPath(p, paint)
        canvas.restore()
    }
    override fun setAlpha(alpha: Int) { paint.alpha = alpha }
    override fun setColorFilter(colorFilter: ColorFilter?) { paint.colorFilter = colorFilter }
    @Suppress("OVERRIDE_DEPRECATION")
    override fun getOpacity(): Int = PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
}

package com.example.webedge

import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.ColorFilter
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.ViewTreeObserver
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.ImageView
import androidx.dynamicanimation.animation.DynamicAnimation
import eightbitlab.com.blurview.BlurTarget

/** Orb chÃ­nh dáº¡ng vÃ²ng nháº«n, phong cÃ¡ch HarmonyOS. */
class RingIcon(color: Int) : Drawable() {
    private val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        this.color = color
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
    }

    override fun draw(canvas: Canvas) {
        val b = bounds
        if (b.width() <= 0 || b.height() <= 0) return

        val strokeWidth = b.width() / 18f
        paint.strokeWidth = strokeWidth
        val cx = b.exactCenterX()
        val cy = b.exactCenterY()
        val radius = minOf(b.width(), b.height()) / 2f - strokeWidth
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, radius, paint)
    }

    override fun setAlpha(alpha: Int) { paint.alpha = alpha }
    override fun setColorFilter(colorFilter: ColorFilter?) { paint.colorFilter = colorFilter }

    @Suppress("OVERRIDE_DEPRECATION")
    override fun getOpacity(): Int = PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
}

class OrbMenuController(
    private val rootLayout: FrameLayout,
    private val blurTarget: BlurTarget,
    private val dp: (Int) -> Int,
    private val d: Float,
    private val isNight: Boolean,
    private val BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP: Int,
    private val onBack: () -> Unit,
    private val onForward: () -> Unit,
    private val onHome: () -> Unit
) {
    private val iconColor = if (isNight) Color.WHITE else Color.rgb(28, 28, 32)

    private var toolbarAvailable = true
    private var temporarilyHidden = false
    private var isExpanded = false
    private var anchorView: View? = null
    private var preDrawListener: ViewTreeObserver.OnPreDrawListener? = null

    private fun createGlass(preset: GlassSystem.Preset): View =
        GlassSystem.createBlurView(rootLayout.context, blurTarget, preset, d, isNight)

    private fun createIcon(path: String?, ring: Boolean = false): ImageView =
        ImageView(rootLayout.context).apply {
            setImageDrawable(if (ring) RingIcon(iconColor) else PathIcon(path ?: "", iconColor))
            scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER
            setPadding(dp(7), dp(7), dp(7), dp(7))
            importantForAccessibility = View.IMPORTANT_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY_NO
        }

    private val mainBtn = FrameLayout(rootLayout.context).apply {
        isClickable = true
        isFocusable = true
        clipChildren = true
        clipToPadding = true
        contentDescription = "Má»Ÿ Ä‘iá»u hÆ°á»›ng nhanh"
        addView(createGlass(GlassSystem.Preset.ORB_BUTTON), FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
        addView(
            createIcon(null, ring = true).apply { setPadding(dp(8), dp(8), dp(8), dp(8)) },
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1)
        )
        elevation = dp(3).toFloat()
    }

    private val subBtns = mutableListOf<FrameLayout>()

    init {
        rootLayout.addView(
            mainBtn,
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams(dp(BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP), dp(BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP)).apply {
                gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
                leftMargin = dp(16)
                topMargin = dp(16)
            }
        )
        mainBtn.setOnClickListener { toggle() }
        AnimationSystem.attachGlassPress(mainBtn)

        val icons = listOf(Icons.ARROW_BACK, Icons.ARROW_FORWARD, Icons.HOME)
        val labels = listOf("Quay láº¡i", "Tiáº¿n tá»›i", "Trang chá»§")
        val actions = listOf(onBack, onForward, onHome)

        for (i in icons.indices) {
            val btn = FrameLayout(rootLayout.context).apply {
                isClickable = true
                isFocusable = true
                contentDescription = labels[i]
                clipChildren = true
                clipToPadding = true
                addView(createGlass(GlassSystem.Preset.ORB_SUB_BUTTON), FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
                addView(createIcon(icons[i]), FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
                setOnClickListener {
                    if (isAvailable()) {
                        actions[i]()
                        collapse()
                    }
                }
                AnimationSystem.attachGlassPress(this)
                visibility = View.GONE
                scaleX = 0f
                scaleY = 0f
                alpha = 0f
                elevation = dp(3).toFloat()
            }
            rootLayout.addView(
                btn,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams(dp(32), dp(32)).apply {
                    gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
                    leftMargin = dp(20)
                    topMargin = dp(20)
                }
            )
            subBtns.add(btn)
        }
        applyAvailability()
    }

    fun alignWith(backBtn: View) {
        anchorView?.viewTreeObserver?.let { oldObserver ->
            preDrawListener?.let { if (oldObserver.isAlive) oldObserver.removeOnPreDrawListener(it) }
        }
        anchorView = backBtn
        updatePosition()
        val listener = ViewTreeObserver.OnPreDrawListener {
            updatePosition()
            true
        }
        preDrawListener = listener
        backBtn.viewTreeObserver.addOnPreDrawListener(listener)
    }

    /** Sync visibility with the real toolbar state (including auto-hide). */
    fun setToolbarAvailable(available: Boolean) {
        if (toolbarAvailable == available) {
            applyAvailability()
            return
        }
        toolbarAvailable = available
        if (!available) collapseImmediately()
        applyAvailability()
        updatePosition()
    }

    /**
     * Remove OrbMenu views from the root while FindBar/IME overlays are active.
     * This is stronger than visibility alone and prevents stale/animated views
     * from remaining above the FindBar or receiving touches.
     */
    fun setTemporarilyHidden(hidden: Boolean) {
        temporarilyHidden = hidden
        if (hidden) {
            collapseImmediately()
            AnimationSystem.cancel(mainBtn)
            mainBtn.alpha = 0f
            mainBtn.isClickable = false
            mainBtn.isEnabled = false
            mainBtn.isFocusable = false
            mainBtn.visibility = View.GONE
            subBtns.forEach { btn ->
                AnimationSystem.cancel(btn)
                btn.alpha = 0f
                btn.scaleX = 0f
                btn.scaleY = 0f
                btn.isClickable = false
                btn.isEnabled = false
                btn.visibility = View.GONE
            }
            // Detaching guarantees the menu cannot overlay FindBar or intercept touches.
            (mainBtn.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(mainBtn)
            subBtns.forEach { btn -> (btn.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(btn) }
        } else {
            if (mainBtn.parent == null) {
                rootLayout.addView(mainBtn, mainBtn.layoutParams ?: FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                    dp(BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP), dp(BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT_DP)
                ).apply { gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START; leftMargin = dp(16); topMargin = dp(16) })
            }
            subBtns.forEachIndexed { index, btn ->
                if (btn.parent == null) {
                    val params = btn.layoutParams ?: FrameLayout.LayoutParams(dp(32), dp(32)).apply {
                        gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
                        leftMargin = dp(20)
                        topMargin = dp(20)
                    }
                    rootLayout.addView(btn, params)
                }
            }
            mainBtn.alpha = 1f
            applyAvailability()
            updatePosition()
        }
    }

    private fun isAvailable(): Boolean = toolbarAvailable && !temporarilyHidden

    private fun applyAvailability() {
        val available = isAvailable()
        mainBtn.visibility = if (available) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        mainBtn.isClickable = available
        mainBtn.isEnabled = available
        mainBtn.isFocusable = available
        if (!available) {
            subBtns.forEach {
                AnimationSystem.cancel(it)
                it.visibility = View.GONE
                it.isClickable = false
                it.isEnabled = false
                it.alpha = 0f
                it.scaleX = 0f
                it.scaleY = 0f
                it.translationX = 0f
                it.translationY = 0f
            }
        } else {
            subBtns.forEach { it.isClickable = isExpanded; it.isEnabled = isExpanded }
        }
    }

    private fun updatePosition() {
        val anchor = anchorView ?: return
        if (anchor.width <= 0) {
            applyAvailability()
            return
        }

        val loc = IntArray(2)
        val rootLoc = IntArray(2)
        anchor.getLocationInWindow(loc)
        rootLayout.getLocationInWindow(rootLoc)
        val x = loc[0] - rootLoc[0]
        val y = loc[1] - rootLoc[1]

        val mainParams = mainBtn.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams
        if (mainParams.leftMargin != x || mainParams.topMargin != y ||
            mainParams.gravity != (Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START)
        ) {
            mainParams.leftMargin = x
            mainParams.topMargin = y
            mainParams.gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            mainBtn.layoutParams = mainParams
        }

        subBtns.forEach { btn ->
            val params = btn.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams
            val newX = x + dp(4)
            val newY = y + dp(4)
            if (params.leftMargin != newX || params.topMargin != newY ||
                params.gravity != (Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START)
            ) {
                params.leftMargin = newX
                params.topMargin = newY
                params.gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
                btn.layoutParams = params
            }
        }
        applyAvailability()
    }

    fun toggle() {
        if (!isAvailable()) return
        if (isExpanded) collapse() else expand()
    }

    private fun expand() {
        if (!isAvailable()) return
        isExpanded = true
        AnimationSystem.spring(mainBtn, DynamicAnimation.ROTATION, 45f, AnimationSystem.SNAPPY)

        val radius = dp(60).toFloat()
        val angles = listOf(-90.0, -45.0, 0.0)
        for (i in subBtns.indices) {
            val angle = Math.toRadians(angles[i])
            val dx = (radius * kotlin.math.cos(angle)).toFloat()
            val dy = (radius * kotlin.math.sin(angle)).toFloat()
            val btn = subBtns[i]
            AnimationSystem.cancel(btn)
            btn.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            btn.isClickable = true
            btn.isEnabled = true
            btn.alpha = 0f
            btn.scaleX = 0f
            btn.scaleY = 0f
            // Má»—i nÃºt con hÆ¡i cháº­m hÆ¡n nÃºt trÆ°á»›c, táº¡o cáº£m giÃ¡c bung ra láº§n lÆ°á»£t nhÆ° iOS.
            val spec = AnimationSystem.SpringSpec(0.40f + i * 0.04f, AnimationSystem.BOUNCY.dampingRatio)
            AnimationSystem.spring(btn, DynamicAnimation.TRANSLATION_X, dx, spec)
            AnimationSystem.spring(btn, DynamicAnimation.TRANSLATION_Y, dy, spec)
            AnimationSystem.scaleTo(btn, 1f, 1f, spec)
            AnimationSystem.fade(btn, 1f, AnimationSystem.QUICK)
        }
    }

    private fun collapse() {
        if (!isExpanded) return
        isExpanded = false
        AnimationSystem.spring(mainBtn, DynamicAnimation.ROTATION, 0f, AnimationSystem.SNAPPY)
        subBtns.forEach { btn ->
            btn.isClickable = false
            btn.isEnabled = false
            AnimationSystem.cancel(btn)
            AnimationSystem.spring(btn, DynamicAnimation.TRANSLATION_X, 0f, AnimationSystem.SMOOTH)
            AnimationSystem.spring(btn, DynamicAnimation.TRANSLATION_Y, 0f, AnimationSystem.SMOOTH)
            AnimationSystem.scaleTo(btn, 0f, 0f, AnimationSystem.DISMISS)
            AnimationSystem.fade(btn, 0f, AnimationSystem.DISMISS) {
                if (!isExpanded) btn.visibility = View.GONE
            }
        }
    }

    private fun collapseImmediately() {
        isExpanded = false
        AnimationSystem.cancel(mainBtn)
        mainBtn.rotation = 0f
        subBtns.forEach { btn ->
            AnimationSystem.cancel(btn)
            btn.visibility = View.GONE
            btn.isClickable = false
            btn.isEnabled = false
            btn.alpha = 0f
            btn.scaleX = 0f
            btn.scaleY = 0f
            btn.translationX = 0f
            btn.translationY = 0f
        }
    }

    fun destroy() {
        anchorView?.viewTreeObserver?.let { observer ->
            preDrawListener?.let { if (observer.isAlive) observer.removeOnPreDrawListener(it) }
        }
        preDrawListener = null
        anchorView = null
        isExpanded = false
        AnimationSystem.cancel(mainBtn)
        mainBtn.setOnClickListener(null)
        subBtns.forEach {
            AnimationSystem.cancel(it)
            it.setOnClickListener(null)
            rootLayout.removeView(it)
        }
        rootLayout.removeView(mainBtn)
        subBtns.clear()
    }
}

===== ./app/src/main/java/com/example/webedge/TabManager.kt =====

package com.example.webedge

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.webkit.WebView

/** Quáº£n lÃ½ tab; má»—i tab giá»¯ WebView riÃªng Ä‘á»ƒ giá»¯ nguyÃªn phiÃªn trang khi chuyá»ƒn tab. */
class TabManager {
    data class Tab(
        val id: Long = System.nanoTime(),
        var url: String = "",
        var title: String = "",
        var isActive: Boolean = false,
        var webView: WebView? = null,
        var thumbnail: Bitmap? = null,
        var thumbnailUrl: String? = null
    )

    private val tabs = mutableListOf<Tab>()
    private var listener: (() -> Unit)? = null

    init { tabs.add(Tab(isActive = true)) }

    fun setOnChangeListener(l: () -> Unit) { listener = l }
    fun getAll(): List<Tab> = tabs.toList()
    fun getActive(): Tab? = tabs.find { it.isActive }
    fun getById(id: Long): Tab? = tabs.find { it.id == id }
    fun getForWebView(view: WebView): Tab? = tabs.find { it.webView === view }
    fun count(): Int = tabs.size

    /** Xuáº¥t metadata Ä‘á»ƒ lÆ°u bá»n vá»¯ng; WebView Ä‘Æ°á»£c táº¡o láº¡i khi cáº§n. */
    fun exportTabs(): List<PersistedTab> = tabs.map {
        PersistedTab(
            id = it.id,
            url = it.webView?.url ?: it.url,
            title = it.webView?.title ?: it.title,
            isActive = it.isActive
        )
    }

    /** KhÃ´i phá»¥c danh sÃ¡ch tab Ä‘Ã£ lÆ°u mÃ  chÆ°a táº¡o WebView cho tab ná»n. */
    fun restoreTabs(saved: List<PersistedTab>) {
        if (saved.isEmpty()) return

        tabs.clear()
        val restored = saved.takeLast(100)
        val ids = mutableSetOf<Long>()

        restored.forEachIndexed { index, item ->
            var id = item.id
            if (id == 0L || id in ids) {
                id = System.nanoTime() + index + 1L
                while (id == 0L || id in ids) id++
            }
            ids.add(id)

            tabs.add(
                Tab(
                    id = id,
                    url = item.url,
                    title = item.title.ifBlank { item.url.ifBlank { "Tab má»›i" } },
                    isActive = item.isActive
                )
            )
        }

        if (tabs.none { it.isActive }) {
            tabs.first().isActive = true
        } else {
            var foundActive = false
            tabs.forEach {
                if (it.isActive && !foundActive) {
                    foundActive = true
                } else if (it.isActive) {
                    it.isActive = false
                }
            }
        }
    }


    fun addNew(url: String = "", title: String = "Tab má»›i"): Tab {
        tabs.forEach { it.isActive = false }
        val tab = Tab(url = url, title = title, isActive = true)
        tabs.add(tab)
        listener?.invoke()
        return tab
    }

    fun switchTo(id: Long): Tab? {
        val target = tabs.find { it.id == id } ?: return null
        tabs.forEach { it.isActive = (it.id == id) }
        listener?.invoke()
        return target
    }

    /** Tráº£ tab Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng Ä‘á»ƒ Activity cÃ³ thá»ƒ destroy WebView Ä‘Ãºng vÃ²ng Ä‘á»i. */
    fun close(id: Long): Tab? {
        if (tabs.size <= 1) return null
        val idx = tabs.indexOfFirst { it.id == id }
        if (idx < 0) return null
        val removed = tabs.removeAt(idx)
        if (removed.isActive) {
            val next = if (idx < tabs.size) tabs[idx] else tabs.last()
            tabs.forEach { it.isActive = (it === next) }
        }
        listener?.invoke()
        return removed
    }

    /** LÆ°u metadata vÃ  thumbnail cá»§a WebView hiá»‡n táº¡i trÆ°á»›c khi rá»i tab. */
    fun saveState(web: WebView) {
        val tab = getForWebView(web) ?: getActive() ?: return
        tab.url = web.url ?: tab.url
        tab.title = web.title ?: tab.title
        captureThumbnail(tab, web)
        listener?.invoke()
    }

    private fun captureThumbnail(tab: Tab, web: WebView) {
        try {
            val w = web.width
            val h = web.height
            if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return
            // Váº½ trá»±c tiáº¿p vÃ o bitmap nhá», trÃ¡nh táº¡o bitmap toÃ n mÃ n hÃ¬nh rá»“i scale (tá»‘n RAM).
            val targetWidth = (180f * web.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
            val targetHeight = (targetWidth.toFloat() * h / w).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
            val scaled = Bitmap.createBitmap(targetWidth, targetHeight, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            val canvas = Canvas(scaled)
            canvas.drawColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE)
            canvas.scale(targetWidth.toFloat() / w, targetHeight.toFloat() / h)
            web.draw(canvas)
            tab.thumbnail?.takeIf { it !== scaled }?.recycle()
            tab.thumbnail = scaled
            tab.thumbnailUrl = tab.url
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            // Giá»¯ thumbnail gáº§n nháº¥t náº¿u frame hiá»‡n táº¡i chÆ°a thá»ƒ chá»¥p.
        }
    }

    fun updateForWebView(web: WebView, url: String, title: String) {
        val tab = getForWebView(web) ?: return
        if (url.isNotBlank()) tab.url = url
        if (title.isNotBlank()) tab.title = title
        listener?.invoke()
    }

    fun updateActive(url: String, title: String) {
        getActive()?.let {
            if (url.isNotBlank()) it.url = url
            if (title.isNotBlank()) it.title = title
        }
        listener?.invoke()
    }
}

===== ./app/src/main/java/com/example/webedge/PillProgress.kt =====

package com.example.webedge

import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.ColorFilter
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Path
import android.graphics.PathMeasure
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.graphics.RectF
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable

// VÃ²ng tiáº¿n trÃ¬nh cháº¡y dá»c theo viá»n Ã´ Ä‘á»‹a chá»‰ hÃ¬nh viÃªn thuá»‘c
class PillProgress(color: Int, private val strokePx: Float) : Drawable() {
    private val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private val path = Path()
    private val seg = Path()
    private val measure = PathMeasure()
    private var length = 0f

    var progress: Float = 0f
        set(v) {
            field = v.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
            invalidateSelf()
        }

    init {
        paint.color = color
        paint.style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        paint.strokeWidth = strokePx
        paint.strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
    }

    override fun onBoundsChange(bounds: Rect) {
        path.reset()
        val half = strokePx / 2f
        val rect = RectF(
            bounds.left + half,
            bounds.top + half,
            bounds.right - half,
            bounds.bottom - half
        )
        val r = minOf(rect.width(), rect.height()) / 2f
        path.addRoundRect(rect, r, r, Path.Direction.CW)
        measure.setPath(path, false)
        length = measure.length
    }

    override fun draw(canvas: Canvas) {
        if (progress <= 0f || progress >= 1f || length <= 0f) return
        seg.reset()
        measure.getSegment(0f, length * progress, seg, true)
        canvas.drawPath(seg, paint)
    }

    override fun setAlpha(alpha: Int) {
        paint.alpha = alpha
    }

    override fun setColorFilter(colorFilter: ColorFilter?) {
        paint.colorFilter = colorFilter
    }

    @Suppress("OVERRIDE_DEPRECATION")
    override fun getOpacity(): Int = PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
}
